# ChongGrok AI Membership Recharge Services and Guides

> ChongGrok provides ChatGPT, Grok, Claude and Gemini membership recharge assistance with Alipay or WeChat Pay, account-safety guidance and product-specific troubleshooting resources.

Official guide portal: https://guides.chonggrok.com/
Service website: https://chonggrok.com/
Cross-product knowledge center: https://he20000405-pixel.github.io/

## Service overview

- ChatGPT: own-account Plus and Pro membership assistance. Plus has a self-service redemption route; Pro options require an account and delivery check.
- Grok: own-account SuperGrok service using a Grok User ID. A User ID identifies the target account and is not a password.
- Claude: own-account Pro and Max subscription assistance. The User ID used by ChongGrok is a fulfillment identifier, not an Anthropic subscription requirement.
- Gemini: Gemini and Google AI membership services. Account type, delivery method and support terms depend on the selected product-page offer.
- Alipay and WeChat Pay are supported.
- Passwords, verification codes and recovery codes are not requested.

## Safety and business boundaries

- ChatGPT, Grok and Claude services primarily use the customer's own account.
- Product-specific session credentials and User IDs remain sensitive and must not be posted publicly.
- Existing, completed or pending charges should be investigated before another purchase.
- ChongGrok does not provide API credits, API billing, SMS verification, bulk registration or platform-restriction circumvention.
- ChongGrok is an independent third-party service and is not affiliated with OpenAI, xAI, X, Anthropic, Google or Apple.
- Product features, limits, prices and regional availability are controlled by the respective providers and may change.
